limitations: Receiver-local durations are not capture-to-photon latency.
GL draw and browser compositor submission are different endpoints.
Browser RVFC observations miss frames under UI pressure; coverage is reported, not called dropped FPS.
Browser actual decoder implementation was not exposed; hardware decode is required by native vtdec_hw.
Same physical Ethernet LAN; compare selected transport explicitly; no WAN or 5G acceptance.
DOM/JS CPU load only; 3D/GPU saturation, reconnect, native driving readiness and input latency remain untested.
Other Mac workloads are not fully isolated; remote competitor monitoring samples once per second.
Original B-A-B mixed native UDP with browser TCP; those absolute differences cannot isolate the receiver. A later native TCP run provides a protocol-matched comparison.
Runs use recorded revisions: original three at 4635153; native TCP at e997de7. UI load and media pipeline retained; transport admission and shutdown handling changed.
Browser TCP baseline and later native TCP are sequential, not randomized or contemporaneous; Mac background work is not controlled.
Matched TCP protocol still has different address families: browser IPv4 and native IPv6 link-local, on the Orin gbe1 physical link; candidate identities are not identical.
